sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct is a 70-billion parameter multilingual language model developed by meta-llama and released December 6, 2024. This instruction-tuned transformer uses supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback to optimize for dialogue and helpful, safe responses across eight languages: English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and ...

sources.snippet: Model Information The Meta Llama 3.3 multilingual large language model (LLM) is a pretrained and instruction tuned generative model in 70B (text in/text out). The Llama 3.3 instruction-tuned text-only model is optimized for multilingual dialogue use cases and outperform many of the available open source and closed chat models on common industry benchmarks. Models are accelerated by TensorRT ...

sources.snippet: Introduction Llama 3.3 is a text-only 70B instruction-tuned model that provides enhanced performance relative to Llama 3.1 70B-and relative to Llama 3.2 90B when used for text-only applications. Moreover, for some applications, Llama 3.3 70B approaches the performance of Llama 3.1 405B.
